about: The test sweep's pass bar (R7, the user's call, 2026-11-13), committed before the sweep. precision: flags hand-checked right over all flags. strict_recall: strict labels caught over strict labels, a catch being a flag on the label's own target saying its own complaint; recall_includes_prose_only counts the labels no flag can match (a root_cause sentence, an inference, or the unsupported complaint) in the denominator. judge_if_prose_share_at_least: R4's trigger, the prose-only share of strict labels. frozen: set true in the freeze commit (the redesign's step 8, 2026-11-16); from then on the scorer takes the commit that last changed this file as the freeze, and refuses a sweep that ran before it or on different frozen_paths, or one scored with frozen_paths changed since. fixed_from_sweep: the scenarios and the recorded windows, which grow after the freeze (the test breaks are made after it), held to the sweep's own commit instead: they must be as they were when the sweep ran.
